_about: The first launch (docs/first-launch-story.md, 'Zafar's flow'), played by js/shared/story.js on first.html. Scenes run in order; where the player is is kept in their save (namespace 'story', {"first-launch": {at, started}}), so a reload picks up at the same scene (a panel story from its first panel; a Cook round starts again). Kinds: character (make your character), scene (a picture, Nani, the child, one or more lines, then the big arrow), cook (a Cook round, which comes back here with done=<scene id>), panels (a picture story, one line per panel), choice (Yes/No: only Yes works; No dodges and Nani laughs), end (sets the flag and goes home). Lines are said in English, then Kutchi (the 'Story help' parent setting can make it Kutchi only). Kutchi marked placeholder: true is Claude's or Zafar's draft until Mum records it; 'clip' is a family recording (data/family-audio.json id, 'speaker' default mum) and is only given where it says exactly the Kutchi shown.
